guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice shows the largest anomaly in the digest: p90 latency rose from 0.0046 to 1.68 (z=+7219), CPU rose from 0.31 to 18.3 (+5868%), and memory rose about 5x, while its callers show only a smaller latency increase (checkoutservice p90 0.24 to 1.84) and unrelated services such as cartservice, adservice and productcatalogservice are flat. CPU is chosen over mem because its z-score is much larger (+630 vs +84) and it fits the latency growth, but the memory increase is also notable and logs contain no warnings or errors to separate the two; the listed trace chains appear to be a flattened path rather than true call edges (emailservice is only called by checkoutservice in the service map).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for runaway CPU use (hot loop or heavy request handling), then restart or scale out its replicas and apply CPU limits; verify checkoutservice latency recovers.
